#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
enum Topic {
    Politics,
    Technology,
    Sports,
    Entertainment,
    Other(String),
}


#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
struct NewsArticleAnalysis {
    topic: Topic,
    sentiment: SentimentClassification,
    entities: Vec<Entity>,
    key_points: Vec<String>,
}
